items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_le_degrees_card
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : p.totalDegree ≤ p.degrees.card

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_eq
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : p.totalDegree = p.support.sup fun m => (Finsupp.toMultiset m).card
